## Docket 1.2.8

**"Check now" tells you it is still going.**

Pressing Check now on a watchlist site said the audit was running in the
background and then went quiet — no progress, no way to tell whether it was
still working, and no way to tell whether it had failed.

It now shows what the check is doing beside the button — the phase it is in and
how many pages it has read — and the button stays disabled until it finishes, so
a second press cannot start a second crawl of the same site without saying so.

A check that **fails** now says so. Previously the failure was recorded but
never surfaced, so a failed check looked exactly like one still running, and
went on looking that way indefinitely.

The state survives a reload. Reopening the site, or restarting the app while a
check is in progress, now shows the check still running instead of losing track
of it.
